Across the grid and shell packets, 12 raw commit-object copies represent five distinct commits 6533, 95e, f82, 98cc and d7. privacy_review.limits: Selected Unix/Windows/escaped paths, email, private-key and credential patterns only; UTF-8 textual views, gzip and recognized ustar tar, depth 18, 128 MiB per view, tree names and gzip/tar metadata. Non-UTF-8 text, unknown roots, encodings, credentials, archive types and personally identifying content not matching the patterns remain unassessed. This is not complete privacy clearance.
